people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
translations.bsb: Zebulun shall dwell by the seashore and become a harbor for ships; his border shall extend to Sidon.
translations.kjv: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
translations.asv: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; And he shall be for a haven of ships; And his border shall be upon Sidon.
